s.note: Puff pastry cups filled with ham, cheddar and egg custard
s.how: Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 12 rounds and press into a greased mini muffin tray. Whisk 4 eggs with 150ml cream, then stir through 100g diced ham and 80g grated cheddar. Fill the cases and bake at 190C for 18 minutes until puffed and set.

s.note: Warm corn chips with chunky guacamole and pico de gallo at the X-Con office
s.how: Heat the oven to 160C and warm the corn chips on a tray for 5 minutes. Mash the avocados roughly with half the lime juice, a third of the onion and salt. Mix the tomatoes, the rest of the onion, the jalapeño, chopped coriander and the rest of the lime juice for the pico de gallo. Spoon the pico de gallo over the guacamole and serve with the warm chips.

m.note: Grilled chipotle lime chicken in corn tortillas with pineapple salsa
m.how: Marinate 800g chicken thighs in chopped chipotle, lime juice and salt for an hour. Grill until charred and slice. Dice pineapple with a little onion and lime for salsa. Fill warm corn tortillas with the chicken, salsa and a spoon of sour cream.

w.note: Raspberry, lime, blue and orange jelly layers topped with whipped cream
w.how: Make up raspberry jelly with half the water and pour a thin layer into clear glasses, then chill an hour. Repeat with lime, then blue, then orange jelly, letting each set before the next goes on. Top with whipped cream just before serving.

w.note: One big chocolate chip cookie baked in a pan, soft in the centre
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, then beat in an egg. Mix in 200g flour and 150g dark chocolate chips. Press into a greased ovenproof pan and bake at 180C for 20 minutes until golden at the edges and soft in the centre. Cut into wedges.

d.note: Root beer poured over vanilla ice cream in frosted mugs
d.how: Freeze 4 glass mugs for an hour. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream into each frozen mug. Tilt the mug and slowly pour in about 250ml cold root beer down the side, letting it foam up over the ice cream, then top up as the foam settles. Add a spoon of whipped cream and a cherry, and serve with a straw and a long spoon.
